subject.title: feat(diagnostics-otel): identify each instance with service.instance.id

question: Should diagnostics-otel accept a new OpenClaw-specific `OTEL_SERVICE_INSTANCE_ID` plus hostname fallback, or should this PR wait for the canonical resource-identity design in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/93071?
rationale: The choice sets an operator-facing env/default identity contract and affects telemetry privacy, uniqueness, and standard OpenTelemetry precedence; automation cannot safely choose that product/API direction.

options.title: Wait For Canonical Identity Design
options.body: Remove or pause this branch until the canonical issue settles the approved unique instance source, standard env behavior, docs, and exported-resource proof.

options.title: Adopt The New Env Contract
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally accept `OTEL_SERVICE_INSTANCE_ID`, but then precedence, docs, privacy expectations, and upgrade behavior should be explicit before merge.

options.title: Use Standard Resource Attributes Only
options.body: Drop the new env knob and document/prove `OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES=service.instance.id=...` as the supported override while a future OpenClaw-owned identity seam is designed.

recommendation.title: Wait For Canonical Identity Design
recommendation.body: Remove or pause this branch until the canonical issue settles the approved unique instance source, standard env behavior, docs, and exported-resource proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Current resource-block blame and prior diagnostics-otel feature history make `steipete` the best available routing owner for the env/default identity contract decision.
